title: Approve CORELINE's mobile composition
question: Choose the composition that should govern the build. Use the note field if specific parts should be combined or revised before approval.

options.label: Status Gate
options.lineage: premium fitness dashboard with a dominant player-status window
options.thesis: The whole day resolves into one status view and one decisive training action.
options.viewport: An anonymous athlete status plane and Today overview lead into training, nutrition, recovery, and supplements.
options.risk: The large figure reduces space for detailed daily controls on short phones.

options.label: Quest First
options.lineage: decisive game-menu choreography translated into a training choice
options.thesis: Every day begins by choosing to build a workout or generate the plan.
options.viewport: A diagonal training chamber dominates while food, supplements, recovery, Guide, and navigation remain one thumb away.
options.risk: The action focus gives profile and trend information less opening-screen presence.

options.label: Profile Codex
options.lineage: a personal status dossier expanded into an editable lifestyle plan
options.thesis: The user’s own profile becomes the command center for the entire plan.
options.viewport: An anonymous profile dossier opens into lifestyle, training, food, sleep, and supplement modules.
options.risk: Information density must be carefully reduced for 320-pixel screens.
